metadata.name: Marine Trawl Sampling Events for Scomber scombrus in North Sea Coastal Waters
metadata.description: Dataset containing 6 marine trawl sampling events conducted in the North Sea near Sylt, Germany, between June and September 2021. Records include start and end coordinates, bathymetric depth, timestamps, habitat classification, and biological metrics for Atlantic mackerel (Scomber scombrus) including total length and count, alongside environmental parameters such as salinity and temperature.
metadata.spatial: Point locations with paired start and end coordinates defining short trawl paths (approx. 15-20 min duration)
metadata.temporal: Event-based sampling with irregular intervals; 5 events in June 2021 and 1 event in September 2021
